paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters remains ongoing, with 27 cases reported across 12 states and 5 hospitalizations as of October 19 [1]. Consumers who purchased raw oysters should be cautious, though specific brands or suppliers have not been identified in available reports [1].

Imperio Distribution LLC recalled 2 oz. sealed bags of "IMPERIO FUEGO BEEF JERKY (CARNE SECA)" produced without federal inspection in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, and Wisconsin [2][16]. Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2-Pound Mung Beans are being recalled due to potential glass contamination [3]. WinCo Foods is recalling WinCo Foods Brand Hoagie Rolls because they contain undeclared sesame [4].

The FDA issued a public warning about cold smoked sprats from D&M Smoked Fish Inc. (doing business as Haifa Smoked Fish Inc.) due to botulism risk; the company refused to recall the product [17]. Wild West Seed Inc. is recalling approximately 10,000 pounds of broccoli sprouting seeds—both Broccoli Seeds Green Sprouting Calabrese lot #4105 in 50-pound bags and Wild West Seeds Broccoli Waltham29 Seeds lot #4475—because of Salmonella contamination [19].
